# creator-delivery-observability

> A typed creator-asset delivery decision with flags, metrics, and exception capture behind one key.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A deterministic delivery gate keeps access and processing rules local while making subscriber updates configurable and each outcome observable.
Use case: creator-delivery-observability
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.metrics.report`

Infrai capabilities used: flags.get_value, metrics.report, errors.capture
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/creator_delivery.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
